item.title: IDF investigating: Did AFP photographer have prior knowledge of attack?
item.description: The IDF is examining whether a photographer working for the French news agency AFP, who filmed the terrorists during the pursuit, had received advance information about the attack. At this stage, the matter remains under investigation, and there has been no determination that the photographer had prior knowledge of the attack.

item.title: Following shooting, police to increase vehicle checks
item.description:
Judea and Samaria District Police Commander Chief Superintendent Moshe Pinchi conducted a situational assessment following the attack this morning (Friday) at the Yehuda Junction and ordered increased activity on the roads, including checking vehicles and suspects and seizing vehicles that were taken off the road.
The investigation of the attack was assigned to the minority faction in the Judea and Samaria Intelligence Directorate, which will assist the Shin Bet in the investigation.

item.title: Huckabee? Will media give shooting attack same level of coverage as olive harvest?
item.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee reacted to the shooting attack near Hebron and called on the media to provide the same level of coverage for the attack that they gave to other stories.
"The Palestinian terror attack this morning would have been an even worse catastrophic event had the IDF not acted so quickly. Will the media give this as much coverage as when olive pickers get detained for failing to report their activities?" Huckabee wrote on X.

item.title: Yesha Council: This is not a lone terrorist or isolated attack, but a growing threat
item.description:
The head of the Binyamin Council and the chairman of the Yesha Council, Yisrael Ganz, made his way to the scene of the attack at Yehuda Junction. Ganz prayed for the recovery of the wounded and praised the security forces who eliminated the terrorists. He said that thousands of weapons are in the hands of terrorists in Judea and Samaria, and in the last thirty days, 197 terrorist incidents and attacks have been recorded in the area.
Ganz warned against a repeat of the events of October 7: "This is not a lone terrorist or an isolatedattack, but a broad threat that is growing and could end in a major disaster." He said, "To prevent another October 7, the State of Israel must dismantle the Palestinian Authority and regain full control of the territory until terrorism is eliminated."
